original_sentence: Also in California, Bear Robotics has developed a self-guiding robot, Penny, which has so far served 40,000 diners.
translation: 同样在加州，Bear Robotics 研发了自主导航机器人 Penny，目前它已经服务了 4 万名用餐者。

key_vocabulary.usage_note: self-guiding robot 在本句中对应"自主导航机器人"。
so far 在本句中对应"到目前为止"。
serve diners 在本句中对应"服务食客"。
